title: Puharich asks for his papers to be taken away for safety

tellings.quote: these papers I have in my house need someone needs to take them. I don't trust giving them my children for their

plain: A scientist named Puharich, the subject of an episode about a CIA scientist said to have contacted an alien council, reportedly asked in the 1990s that the papers in his house be taken away, saying "I don't trust giving them my children." A researcher on the show repeats this as it was told to them by Puharich's assistant. It is told because it suggests Puharich thought his papers held something worth keeping safe.
